SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.WRITER_NO AS writerNo, P.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, P.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, P.TITLE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.PRICE, P.PRODUCT_CONDITION AS productCondition, P.STATUS, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAtStr, NVL(PM.THUMBNAIL_URL, '/uploads/product/common/default_thumb.png') AS mainImage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS C WHERE C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND C.IS_DELETED = 0) AS commentCount FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE P.WRITER_NO = #{userNo} AND (P.IS_DELETED = 0 OR P.IS_DELETED IS NULL)
AND (P.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentNo, C.PRODUCT_ID AS productNo, C.WRITER_NO AS writerNo, C.PARENT_NO AS parentNo, C.CONTENT, C.IS_DELETED AS isDeleted, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_STR, P.TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE, P.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType, NVL(P.IS_DELETED, 1) AS productDeleted FROM COMMENTS C LEFT JOIN PRODUCTS P ON C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.WRITER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT W.WISHLIST_ID, W.USER_NO, W.PRODUCT_ID AS productNo, W.CREATED_AT, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.AUCTION_START_PRICE, P.TRADE_TYPE, P.STATUS, NVL(PM.THUMBNAIL_URL, '/uploads/product/common/default_thumb.png') AS MAIN_IMAGE, TO_CHAR(W.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS WISHED_AT_STR FROM WISHLISTS W JOIN PRODUCTS P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE W.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RV.VIEW_ID AS viewNo, RV.USER_NO AS userNo, RV.PRODUCT_ID AS productNo, RV.VIEWED_AT AS viewedAt, P.TITLE AS title, P.PRICE AS price, P.STATUS AS status, NVL(PM.THUMBNAIL_URL, '/uploads/product/common/default_thumb.png') AS mainImage, TO_CHAR(RV.VIEWED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS viewedAtStr, P.TRADE_TYPE AS tradeType FROM RECENT_VIEWS RV JOIN PRODUCTS P ON RV.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE RV.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY RV.VIEWED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productNo}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO RECENT_VIEWS RV USING DUAL ON (RV.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND RV.PRODUCT_ID = #{productNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RV.VIEWED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NO, PRODUCT_ID, VIEWED_AT) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{productNo}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
